content:
Based on Qingdengbuyi's Dtide Database.

Data gathered from 488 teams with a score of 450 points.

Wave 1's most used awakener is Mouchette with a play rate of 33.7%. Her most used team is a team with GLotan, Arachne, & Horla. Alternative teammates: Aigis, Helot, Clem, & Thais.
thread_title: Dtide 450 Meta Report October Aequor Ring 2026

content:
Wave 2's most used awakers are Clem & Horla with a play rate of 26.5%. Clem's most used team is with Horla, Kath, & Ryker. Ryker can be replaced with Arachne or Erica. 

Second most used with Clem is a team with Doresain, Pickman, & Thais.

In third place is a team with Pollux, Castor, & Arachne.
thread_title: Dtide 450 Meta Report October Aequor Ring 2026

content:
Wave 3's most used awaker is GDoll with a play rate of 38.4%. Her most used team is in Chaos 24 usually composed of 24, Tawil, & GRamona.  GRamona can be replaced with Lily or Doll.

Alternatively, you can also use a poison team with Xu, Nymph, & Lily. Nymph & Lily can be replaced with Caraboo & Karen.

content: Lemuria dominates Wave 4. Goliath, Miryam & Gmurphy have a play rate of 47.4%.

Saya is the most used awaker of Wave 5 with a play rate of 51%. Her most used team is with Vortice, Murphy, & Salvador.

Salvador can be replaced with Caraboo or Faint.
